# Phase 1 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

**Scope note:** This phase adds `/sign-in` and `/set-password`, the first two pages a member can reach without a session, plus a name and a sign-out button in the existing top bar. No roles work (Phase 2), no steward screens (Phase 3). Everything below reuses the design system already in `components.json` and `frontend/app/globals.css`: no new tokens, no second palette, one new primitive (`Label`).

Choices not taken from CONTEXT.md are the designer's call, as CONTEXT.md leaves the look of the sign-in page and the placement of sign-out open.

## Visual Hierarchy

**Focal point on both pages:** the centred `Card`. It is the only raised surface on a bare `--background` and holds the one filled button on the page.

Reading order inside the card: title, then the failure `Alert` when there is one, then the labelled fields, then the helper line, then the button. The `Alert` sits above the fields so a failure is read before the member returns to the inputs.

| Field label — new password | **"New password"** |

| Wrong credentials | **"Member name or password is wrong."** — the only copy for any mismatch |
| Throttled | **"Too many tries. Wait {duration} and try again."** |
| Session check failed | **"We could not check your session. Sign in again."** |
| Sign-out | **"Sign out"** (icon button label) |
| Empty state | Not applicable — no collection on these pages |

---

## Sign-In Interaction Contract

> These rules carry SIGN-02 and SIGN-05, so they bind the executor and the checker alike.

### 1. The temporary-password gate runs before render

- The proxy checks the session first; a member holding a temporary password is redirected to `/set-password` before any page markup exists.
- The redirect is silent: no toast, no alert.

### 2. Wrong name and wrong password look the same

- Both inputs get invalid styling together on any failure, and focus returns to the name field every time.
- The password field is cleared; the name stays.
- The button disables with a spinner for exactly as long as the request is pending, with no artificial delay.

### 3. No client-side "checking session" state

- The gate is resolved on the server. A reload of a signed-in page yields the page or a redirect, never a flash of the shell first.

---

## Top Bar Addition

- A member name and a sign-out icon button join the right-hand cluster, placed before the theme toggle.
- The name hides below 640px and truncates past 128px.
- With no display name, the sign-in name shows instead; the slot is never blank.
- A failed sign-out request still navigates to `/sign-in`; the proxy decides what happens next.

## UI Considerations

Generated by the ui-consideration-probe against three surfaces (E1 `/sign-in`, E2 `/set-password`, E3 top bar addition). **22 applicable considerations: 16 covered, 1 backstop, 4 dismissed, 1 unresolved.** Copy for empty and error states lives in the Copywriting Contract.

### E1 — `/sign-in`

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Both fields blank on arrival, button disabled until both hold text. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Button disables with a spinner for the pending request only. |
| error | ✅ covered | One alert region above the fields carries the wrong-credentials, throttled and session-check copy. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Both fields filled enables the button; the card does not reflow. |
| partial | ✅ covered | One field filled keeps the button disabled with no inline error. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Length caps on both inputs; long values scroll inside the input. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | The alert holds one fixed sentence at all times. |
| zero-one-many | 🧪 backstop | **Statement:** the wait in the throttled copy reads "1 second", "59 seconds", "1 minute", "2 minutes". **Verification: backstop** — assert each boundary when the copy is built. |

### E2 — `/set-password`

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Both fields blank, helper line visible, button disabled. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Same spinner rule as E1. |
| error | ✅ covered | Checks run on submit only; the too-short message wins when two fail. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Success redirects to the catalogue with no interstitial. |
| partial | ✅ covered | One field filled keeps the button disabled. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Length cap on both fields. |
| long-text | ⊘ dismissed | **Reason:** the page holds only fixed copy. |
| zero-one-many | ⊘ dismissed | **Reason:** two fixed fields and no collection. |

### E3 — Top bar addition

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | A missing display name falls back to the sign-in name. |
| loading | ⊘ dismissed | **Reason:** the name arrives with the server-rendered session. |
| error | ✅ covered | A failed sign-out still navigates; no alert in the bar. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Name, divider and sign-out button sit before the theme toggle. |
| overflow | ⚠ unresolved | The truncation width was set from two sample names; real long names are untested. |
| long-text | ⊘ dismissed | **Reason:** the span is hidden on narrow screens, so a long name cannot crowd the bar there. |
